research.title: Predictive Calibration Under Covariate Shift
bullets: Designed experiments with supervisor guidance to compare probability calibration methods under controlled changes in feature distributions while preserving conditional label mechanisms.
Evaluated temperature scaling and isotonic regression using reliability diagrams, log loss, and repeated sampling to examine sensitivity to calibration sample composition.

research.title: Regularization Stability with Correlated Predictors
bullets: Planned simulation experiments with supervisor guidance to examine how predictor correlation and signal sparsity affect regularized regression performance.
Compared ridge, lasso, and elastic net using nested cross validation, documenting prediction error and coefficient stability across resampled training sets.

work.title: Batch Data Validation and Processing
bullets: Implemented Python validation routines for incoming tabular records, checking required fields, type consistency, and duplicate identifiers before downstream processing.
Maintained batch processing components and regression tests, reproducing reported failures and documenting expected behavior for malformed inputs and interrupted runs.

projects.title: Classification with Incomplete Tabular Features
bullets: Implemented preprocessing pipelines combining median or iterative imputation with logistic regression and random forests for classification with missing features.
Compared predictive performance across simulated missingness patterns, fitting preprocessing within training folds to prevent information leakage during cross validation.

projects.title: Prediction Intervals for Nonlinear Regression
bullets: Implemented split conformal prediction around linear and random forest regressors, using held out calibration residuals to construct prediction intervals.
Compared empirical coverage and interval width across nonlinear and heteroscedastic simulations, examining conditional coverage patterns within predefined feature ranges.

projects.title: Density Estimation for Multimodal Distributions
bullets: Implemented kernel density estimation and Gaussian mixture baselines, selecting bandwidths and mixture complexity through validation likelihood on synthetic distributions.
Compared held out log likelihood and sensitivity to initialization, using density plots to inspect oversmoothing and poorly represented modes.
